emails.subject: Marketplace: walnut dresser
emails.body: Hi, it's Priya from the Marketplace listing. I can do $120 for the walnut dresser if you can hold it until the weekend — Saturday morning works best for pickup. Send me the address and I'll bring my brother's truck.

emails.subject: Hybrid commuter bike still available?
emails.body: Hey, Marcus here about the bike — $85 as we discussed in chat works for me. I'm free Sunday afternoon; email me where to come and I can Venmo you the same day.
